svg.title: Published and optimized PostgreSQL function service latency
svg.desc: Arithmetic means of two recorded per-run direct latency medians, in milliseconds. Ranked search: published functions 8.39090347290039, optimized functions 6.89399242401123; Search autocomplete: published functions 3.66199016571045, optimized functions 2.89857387542725; Edit a post: published functions 1.731514930725095, optimized functions 1.617908477783205. Service operations only; HTTP routing and template rendering are excluded.
